Hi, I'm Pratyush. I'm studying a Master of Business Analytics at Monash University in Melbourne.

Before Monash, I worked as an Operations Manager in my family's business in India. I also have a Bachelor of Business Administration in Finance and Accounting, and I have passed nine ACCA papers.

On this blog, I take research findings and explain them in plain language, with charts that get straight to the point. I'm interested in Business Analyst and BI Analyst roles.
